headline: Bill placed in Parliament to abolish RAB and create SRB
summary: The proposed Special Response Battalion (SRB) will be as a specialized unit under the police force to fight terrorism, cybercrime, and organized crime.
details: A bill titled the 'Special Response Battalion (SRB) Act, 2026' has been introduced in the National Parliament to abolish the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) and establish a new specialized unit under the police force.
Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed introduced the bill on Thursday, during the fourth day of the third session of the 13th National Parliament.

The bill was subsequently sent to the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Home Affairs for further examination. Opposition leaders, including Chief Whip Nahid Islam and Dr. Shafiqur Rahman, requested more time for the bill's review.

Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed stated that the abolition of RAB was a part of their election manifesto and public demand. He emphasized the need for an elite force under the police to combat modern threats, including advanced cybercrime, gambling, and drugs.

The proposed SRB will be as a specialized unit under the police force, with its headquarters in Dhaka. It will be led by a Director General appointed from among officers of at least Additional Inspector General of Police rank.

The bill specifies that the seorang Director General will have administrative, financial, and operational powers. The personnel of the SRB will be composed of members from the police force, disciplinary forces, and other designated officials.

The SRB's responsibilities will include protecting public security, suppressing terrorism and organized crime, and taking action against drug trafficking, cybercrime, disappearances, and land grabbing.
Additionally, the SRB will be the tasked with combating human trafficking, rape, women and children abuse, and gathering intelligence for law enforcement agencies.
caption:

headline_marked: Over 33,000 reports in US: [[ChatGPT hit by global outage]]
headline: Over 33,000 reports in US: ChatGPT hit by global outage
summary: Users worldwide reported 'Error 404' messages and access issues across web and mobile platforms as OpenAI confirmed the disruption.
details: Users across the globe are currently facing difficulties accessing ChatGPT and other OpenAI services. Many reported seeing 'Error 404' messages when attempting to log in on both web and mobile platforms.
According to Downdetector, the outage peaked at 33,160 reports in the United States alone by 8:51 pm Bangladesh time. In Bangladesh, 221 reports were recorded by 8:57 pm.
OpenAI's official status page confirmed the issue at 8:58 pm Bangladesh time, stating that they were experiencing elevated errors across ChatGPT and Codex.
By 9:22 pm, OpenAI reported that they had applied mitigation measures and were monitoring the recovery of the services as performance remained degraded.
caption:
33,000+ reports in the US alone. ChatGPT is down globally.

Users across the globe are currently facing difficulties accessing ChatGPT and other OpenAI services. Many reported seeing 'Error 404' messages when attempting to log in on both web and mobile platforms.

According to Downdetector, the outage peaked at 33,160 reports in the United States alone by 8:51 pm Bangladesh time. In Bangladesh, 221 reports were recorded by 8:57 pm.

OpenAI's official status page confirmed the issue at 8:58 pm Bangladesh time, stating that they were experiencing elevated errors across ChatGPT and Codex.

By 9:22 pm, OpenAI reported that they had applied mitigation measures and were monitoring the recovery of the services as performance remained degraded.
